scenarios.name: Bull
assumptions: Cloud external revenue sustains >45% YoY growth powered by open-source Qwen LLM enterprise proliferation and public cloud margin expansion to 15%.
Taobao/Tmall take rate expands by 30 bps via Quanzhantui programmatic ad adoption and merchant software service monetization.
AIDC cross-border operations cross into sustainable adjusted EBITA profitability; $12B+ annual share buybacks retire 5%+ of share capital.

scenarios.name: Base
assumptions: Core domestic retail GMV grows 3-4% with market share stabilizing against Douyin and Pinduoduo.
Alibaba Cloud maintains 25-30% organic growth; AI infrastructure investments transition into cash-generative enterprise contracts.
Annual free cash flow exceeds $16B, funding consistent buybacks and a 2.5%+ dividend yield.

scenarios.name: Bear
assumptions: China domestic consumer thrift intensifies, necessitating protracted merchant subsidies and promotional spend.
US and EU cross-border de minimis tariff exemptions are curtailed, constraining AliExpress Choice order velocity.
Accelerated GPU export restrictions restrict cluster expansions, curbing high-margin Cloud AI enterprise workloads.
